page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 4 physical cores, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the ecs.g7.xlarge delivers average single-core capabilities but exhibits weaker multi-core scaling. In stress-ng testing, single-core CPU performance is rated as average, while multi-core performance falls into the weak category. Similarly, Geekbench scores show average single-core performance alongside weak multi-core and software compilation results. Memory bandwidth tests, including read and write operations on large blocks, also rank in the lower percentiles, though passmark memory scores and single-threaded gzip compression remain average.

From a workload perspective, the instance is best suited for general-purpose applications that do not demand intensive multi-threaded processing or high-speed local storage. It is appropriate for lightweight web serving, basic text processing, and small-scale database operations. Given its dedicated CPU allocation and moderate single-core performance, it offers a stable environment for utility workloads, though resource-heavy tasks like ray tracing, large-scale compilation, or high-throughput Redis operations may encounter performance bottlenecks.
